mapper.select: SELECT session_id as sessionId, MAX(CASE WHEN sender_type = 2 THEN sender_name ELSE NULL END) as adminName, MAX(create_time) as lastMessageTime, (SELECT content FROM customer_message cm2 WHERE cm2.session_id = cm.session_id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) as lastMessage, SUM(CASE WHEN is_read = 0 AND receiver_type = 1 AND receiver_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unreadCount FROM customer_message cm WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND sender_type = 1) OR (receiver_id = #{userId} AND receiver_type = 1) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY lastMessageTime DESC
